name: Microsoft Seven Hills (Station Road) Building 2 (SYD08)

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 57 Station Road (site-level; not building-specific)

builder.note: General Contractor for Building Two; Taylor Construction Group prepared the CEMP approved 23 Feb 2023 (source 12); Taylor project code SYD08

mw_it.note: CTMP: 'data-storage capacity of 19.2 megawatts'; EIS (source 8) describes the same 19.2MW as 'Total power consumption capacity up to 19.2 MW', so it may be total load rather than IT

mw_grid.note: EIS: total power consumption up to 19.2MW for SYD08; site total with SYD09 = 20.4MW (EIS Table 7)

authority.note: consent signed by Chris Ritchie, Director Industry Assessments, as delegate of the Minister

lodged.note: not stated; EIS dated 9 June 2022 (source 8); DPE requested agency comments on 11 July 2022 (source 11)

jobs_construction.note: EIS: 'a peak of up to 250 workers per day'; also 'Up to 250 construction jobs'

jobs_construction_other.note: EIS/CTMP: 'typically be around 100 construction workers on site daily'

jobs_operational.note: EIS: '36 operational full time employees' / 'full time staff at the site will comprise 36 operational staff and 4 visitors/contractor staff (e.g. security guards)'

construction_start.note: Microsoft Local: Taylor to start works June 2023. CTMP (source 10) planned Stage 1 structure from Jan 2023; CEMP approved 23 Feb 2023 (source 12)

construction_end.note: planned Sept 2024 (CTMP Stage 2 fit-out end); Microsoft Local Jul 2024: structure, roofing and facade nearing completion; actual completion not published

open_questions: completion date not published; status 'operational' not confirmed by a primary source
mw_it 19.2: CTMP calls it data-storage capacity, EIS calls it total power consumption - IT vs total unclear
